name: @site-studio/serving-core
description: Single source of truth for HTTP-serving logic shared by the app worker (packages/app) and the standalone publisher worker (packages/worker): the SS-8 content-type table, the §3¾ served-content security headers, the dignified fallback 404 page, page-navigation detection, and extensionless-path resolution. Both workers import these TypeScript sources directly; wrangler's esbuild bundles them into each worker at build time (the cross-worker restriction is runtime-only).
